Risk Description: Personal data retained longer than necessary
Control Gap: Retention periods are not consistently documented
Recommended Remediation: Create a formal retention schedule and verify secure deletion

Risk Description: Processing activity lacks documented lawful basis
Existing Control: Lawful basis is known for major processes
Recommended Remediation: Create a centralized lawful basis register for all processing activities

Risk Description: Incomplete personal data inventory causes unmanaged processing risk
Control Gap: Several systems and data flows are missing
Recommended Remediation: Complete the personal data inventory and assign data owners

Risk Description: Delayed response to a data subject access request
Control Gap: Tracking is partly manual and deadlines may be missed
Recommended Remediation: Implement centralized DSAR tracking with deadline alerts

Risk Description: Personal data is not fully erased after a valid deletion request
Recommended Remediation: Implement end-to-end deletion verification and retain evidence
Perform annual privacy and security reviews of high-risk processors

Risk Description: Missing or incomplete Data Processing Agreement
Recommended Remediation: Track DPA status and obtain missing agreements

Risk Description: International transfer occurs without sufficient safeguards
Recommended Remediation: Document transfer mechanisms and complete transfer impact assessments

Risk Description: Consent withdrawal is not properly reflected in downstream systems
Control Gap: Withdrawal evidence and synchronization are inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Centralize consent records and verify downstream suppression

Risk Description: Unnecessary personal data increases breach exposure
Control Gap: Optional or excessive data fields remain in use
Recommended Remediation: Remove unnecessary fields and document business justification

Risk Description: Personal data breach notification is delayed
Control Gap: Privacy-specific escalation and notification testing is inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual privacy breach tabletop exercises

Risk Description: High-risk processing begins without a DPIA
Control Gap: DPIA triggers are not consistently defined
Recommended Remediation: Define DPIA triggers and require assessment before high-risk processing

Risk Description: Privacy compliance evidence cannot be located during an audit
Control Gap: Evidence is fragmented across multiple locations
Recommended Remediation: Create a centralized privacy compliance evidence repository

Existing Control: Use of automated decision-making is limited
Control Gap: Formal governance and safeguards are not consistently documented
Recommended Remediation: Document automated processing reviews and applicable safeguards

Risk Description: Employee or contractor accesses personal data beyond business need
Existing Control: Role-based access controls and security controls exist
Control Gap: Access reviews may not consistently validate privacy-related need
Recommended Remediation: Perform recurring privacy-focused access reviews and remove unnecessary access
